public.text: The wording says worker identity “may cross-reference” foundational identity. The role of foundational identity should remain optional and purpose-specific rather than becoming the sole basis for workforce registration. [draft-for-...idance.pdf | PDF]
public.suggestedRevision: State that the registry may link to foundational identity where legally authorised and useful, while supporting workers who lack, cannot access, or should not be required to disclose such identifiers.
